text:
Nina: repro'd a flaky corruption under heavy multi-tenant churn. differs from previous pin/evict races  it shows up when offload targets cross NUMA nodes. attaching short logs and a tiny repro (spawn 6 tenants, aggressive prefetch+remote-offload).
Rafi: can you paste the minimal trace?
Nina: ```
[2026-01-08T11:03:12Z] tenant=12 prefetch: staged->host (node=1) page=0x8f7c200
[2026-01-08T11:03:12Z] pin: fastpath accepted, tenant=12 tid=1092
[2026-01-08T11:03:12Z] offload-proxy: migrating hostpage node=0 -> node=1 async
[2026-01-08T11:03:12Z] eviction: drop mapping for page=0x8f7c200
[2026-01-08T11:03:12Z] panic: use-after-unmap in remap path
```
Tess: interesting. crossing NUMA makes the remap bounce through the offload proxy which delays completion and widens the race window.
Jon: could be allocator not accounting for "in-flight migration" flag. We have per-page evict bit but not an in-flight-migration bit.
Rafi: options: (a) add migration-inflight bit with same lifetime semantics as pin; (b) require migration to take a lease that blocks eviction until commit; (c) optimistic post-pin validation like we discussed before.
Nina: (b) seems clean: lease prevents eviction until migration finishes. downside: if migrations are slow, hot pages could get pinned too long.
Tess: agree. also we could make migration async but return a short-lived token to the caller that forces revalidation before use. effectively optimistic pin + token validation.
Jon: tradeoffs: leases = strong safety but poor for throughput; tokens = low-overhead but require callers to revalidate (API change).
Rafi: propose hybrid: for cross-NUMA migration, acquire a migration-lease on the page's descriptor (cheap CAS). Fast-path pins check lease flag; if set, they go to retry path that waits on migration completion. For local host remaps we keep optimistic check. This confines overhead to cross-node cases.
Nina: good middle ground. also add a per-tenant migration-credit to avoid noisy tenants monopolizing migration resources. simple token-bucket.
Rafi: test plan: 1) add migration-lease bit + fast-path check, 2) add migration credits, 3) fuzz interleavings with NUMA proxy on CI. Jon take the mock allocator fuzz harness?
Jon: yep will add fuzz and a small integration with numactl in the canary.
deploy-bot: canary queued: canary/migration-lease-probe -> staging (6 GPUs), ETA 4m
Nina: thanks all. I'll open a short RFC follow-up describing the lease bit and tenant-credit proposal.
